title: Tic Tac Toe
desc0: Probably the most hardcore strategy game you have ever dealt with. Fasten your seatbelt and hold on tight!
desc1: In this installment, you have a chance to face the bot, i.e. a combination of ones and zeros that are already in your computer's RAM!
desc2: I think you know the rules. Good luck!
warning: PS. The author is not responsible for damages resulting from uncontrolled emotional reactions caused by frustration after unsuccessful ending of the game.
